title: Juicy Charred Syrian Eggplant Tagine
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Syrian dish featuring charred eggplant, golden syrup, and bonito shave, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and score the flesh in a crisscross pattern.
Brush the eggplants with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the eggplants on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes or until charred.
Remove the eggplants from the oven and let them cool.
Scoop out the flesh of the eggplants and chop it into small pieces.
In a large skillet, heat some olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped eggplant, golden syrup, bonito flakes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir well.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the yogurt and lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
